# {{ site.name | default: site.title }}

{{ site.author.bio | default: site.description }}

Current work spans enterprise semantic layers, personalized search and agents, support automation, multimodal models, post-training, and evaluation. The leadership-coaching work described on the site is a pilot.

Research areas: agents and reasoning; multimodal models and post-training; search and retrieval; evaluation and responsible AI.
